content:
> Fortune Cloud Technologies (FCT) is India's leading AI-integrated IT training and placement institute, headquartered in Pune, Maharashtra, with branch centers in Pimpri, Hadapsar, and Bengaluru (BTM Layout). Established in 2015 as a subsidiary of Cravita Technologies India Pvt. Ltd., FCT offers job-oriented, project-based IT courses designed around real hiring demands — not outdated textbooks. With 5,500+ students successfully placed, 5,000+ hiring partner companies, a 94% placement success rate, and a highest package of 18 LPA, Fortune Cloud Technologies bridges the gap between college education and industry-ready careers in cloud computing, full stack development, data science, cybersecurity, DevOps, AI/ML, SAP, and digital marketing.

content: At Fortune Cloud Technologies, learning happens through doing. Students spend 80% of their training time working on real-world projects that mirror actual industry tasks. No dummy exercises, no copy-paste tutorials. By the time you complete your course, you already have a working portfolio — the kind that gets you hired.

metadata.section: Fortune Cloud Technologies — Complete Guide > Why Choose Fortune Cloud Technologies > 1. Practical Learning (80/20 Model)

content: Our expert trainers are active IT professionals — developers, cloud architects, and DevOps engineers who work in the industry every day. This means students learn the tools, workflows, and best practices that companies actually use right now — not outdated curriculum. Our mentors have placed students at top MNCs across Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad, and Mumbai.

metadata.section: Fortune Cloud Technologies — Complete Guide > Why Choose Fortune Cloud Technologies > 2. Industry Mentors

content: Our placement assistance goes beyond just sharing job links. Our dedicated placement cell works with 5,000+ hiring companies to match the right student to the right role. We cover resume building, aptitude training, mock interviews, and soft skills — giving every tool needed to walk into an interview with confidence and walk out with an offer.

metadata.section: Fortune Cloud Technologies — Complete Guide > Why Choose Fortune Cloud Technologies > 3. 100% Placement Support

content:
Fortune Cloud Technologies centres are built to feel like real IT offices, not classrooms. From day one, students experience a professional work culture — structured working hours, team-based project delivery, and code reviews — so that joining a company after training feels like a natural next step, not a culture shock.

metadata.section: Fortune Cloud Technologies — Complete Guide > Blog & Resources

content:
**Q: What is Fortune Cloud Technologies?**  
A: Fortune Cloud Technologies is an IT training and placement institute in Pune and Bangalore, offering AI-integrated, job-oriented courses in cloud computing, full stack development, data science, cybersecurity, software testing, and more. Established in 2015, it is a subsidiary of Cravita Technologies India Pvt. Ltd.  
**Q: Who should join Fortune Cloud Technologies?**  
A: Fresh graduates (BE, BCA, MCA, BSc, BCom, MBA), working professionals looking to upskill, career switchers wanting to enter IT, and anyone looking for practical, job-oriented IT training with 100% placement support.  
**Q: What is the course duration?**  
A: Most courses are approximately 5 months in duration, with both weekday and weekend batch options available.  
**Q: What are the modes of learning available?**  
A: Classroom (Offline), Online Live, and Hybrid modes are available.  
**Q: Is there a free demo session?**  
A: Yes, you can book a free demo session by visiting https://www.fortunecloudindia.com/Contact or calling +91-9766439090.

metadata.section: Fortune Cloud Technologies — Complete Guide > Frequently Asked Questions > General

content:
**Q: Does Fortune Cloud Technologies provide 100% placement assistance?**  
A: Yes. Fortune Cloud Technologies provides 100% placement assistance to all students who complete their training. With 5,000+ hiring partners and a dedicated placement cell, the institute has a 94% placement success rate.  
**Q: What is the highest package offered to FCT students?**  
A: The highest package secured by an FCT student is 18 LPA (Lakhs Per Annum).  
**Q: Which companies hire from Fortune Cloud Technologies?**  
A: Major MNCs including Cognizant, Capgemini, Accenture, Infosys, TCS, Wipro, and 5,000+ other hiring partner companies.  
**Q: How long does it take to get placed after course completion?**  
A: Most students receive placement within 2–3 months of completing their course.

metadata.section: Fortune Cloud Technologies — Complete Guide > Frequently Asked Questions > Placements

content:
**Q: Are the courses AI-integrated?**  
A: Yes. All technical courses at Fortune Cloud Technologies include AI-powered tools and generative AI modules, keeping students ahead of 2025–2026 industry demands.  
**Q: Do I need prior coding experience?**  
A: No. Most courses are designed for beginners and freshers with zero coding experience. Trainers start from the basics and progressively build up to advanced topics.  
**Q: Will I get a certificate after course completion?**  
A: Yes. All students receive a course completion certificate from Fortune Cloud Technologies upon successfully finishing their training.  
**Q: Are course brochures available for download?**  
A: Yes. Brochures for each course are available for download after submitting an enquiry on the contact page.
